## WireDateSchema variable

Schema for a date control record, `{ "date": "<ISO 8601 text>" }`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
WireDateSchema: z.ZodType<WireDate>
```

## Remarks

The text is `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sss` with exactly three fractional digits, followed by `Z` or `±HH:MM`<!-- -->, and must name a real instant: the day must exist in its month, hours are `00..23`<!-- -->, minutes and seconds `00..59`<!-- -->, offset hours `00..23`<!-- -->, and offset minutes `00..59`<!-- -->.
